newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTS-Warburton says encouraged by Westpac index.
newsitem.headline: RTS-Warburton says encouraged by Westpac index.

text.p: David Jones Ltd chairman and Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) board member Dick Warburton said on Tuesday he was encouraged by the most recent Westpac consumer confidence index.
Addressing David Jones' annual general meeting, Warburton said the number of companies reassessing profit and dividend forecasts reflected widespread depressed consumer confidence.

It was too early to say whether the latest half percent cut in official interest rates would flow through to Christmas sales, but he said he was "highly encouraged" by the November Westpac survey, which jumped 8.3 percent.
The RBA cut official interest rates to 6.50 percent on November 6.
"(The index) is terribly important in the sense that you get a feel for which way people might be going, and its the strongest sign we have seen for quite some time," he later told reporters.
Warburton said it was important to remember that the Westpac index represented only people's hopes.
"But at least if they hopeful things will come good, I feel a bit buoyed by that," he said.
